messages.author: c0afd5ca53ea6f79
messages.subject: possible bug in lstar
parts:
Hi everybody,

just wanted to report a possible bug I encountered some time ago..

Doing this:

#--------------------------------------
require(tsDyn)
set.seed(1)

timeSeries <- c(33, 37, 41, 37, 37, 33, 77, 77, 85, 133, 57, 57, 49, 57, 53, 33, 49, 49, 73,
77, 61, 45, 53, 41, 65, 33, 53, 53, 41, 33, 73, 85, 77, 89, 101, 97, 57, 93,
57, 61, 69)#, 69, 73, 93, 57, 25, 41, 21, 5, 29)


lstarModel <- lstar(timeSeries, m=2, thDelay=1, trace=FALSE, control=list(maxit=1e5))
#--------------------------------------

results in:


Error in if (cost <= bestCost) { : missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed


As you see, some values at the end of the example data series is commented out, because it is normally used as test set. If all available data is used, the error does not occur.

Is the series too short? Am I using lstar not correctly?

Regards,
Christoph
